o Net Zero & Climate Risk Working Forum ("NZCRWF"): A global quarterly bimonthly

forum/working group with representation from key stakeholders across Client Coverage, Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) Team, Credit Officers/Industries Risk, ESGR Client Risk Management team was established under the purview of the CIB Client Review Committee ("CRC") in 2023. The purpose of the forum is to review, challenge, agree and monitor progress against action plans for clients that are high climate risk and/or are misaligned from the Group’s committed NZ pathways.
